summary: Full end-to-end frontend testing of RolliSuite prototype (Vite + React 18 + TS, no backend, fixture-driven). Executed all 13 features listed in the review request. Result: 12/13 features fully working, 1 minor data-fixture discrepancy (MM hit-list count). No console errors, no critical issues.
action_items: MINOR (data): Spec expects 'hit-filter-mm shows only MM items (4)' but fixtures currently render 3 MM hit-list items (h-02, h-08, h-10). Either add one more MM-owned item to /app/frontend/src/api/fixtures/hitList (or equivalent) OR update the spec to match actual data (3).
critical_code_review_comments: Sign-in UX nit: clicking a badge-hint (badge-hint-vienna) fills the input but shifts focus to the button, so pressing Enter afterwards does not submit. Users must click 'Sign in' or click back into the input. Consider auto-submitting on hint click, or refocusing the input after fill, to satisfy the acceptance criterion 'submit signs in as Vienna' being one-step.

success_rate.frontend: ~99% (12/13 features fully pass; 1 fixture count off by 1)

test_credentials: Badge codes: michael, walter, mm (manager) / vienna (concierge). No passwords.

However focus moves to the hint button so a subsequent Enter does not submit; had to re-focus input then Enter. After submit, sidebar-tier='concierge' and 6 nav items shown (Dashboard, Hit List, Intake, Estimates, Labels, Help) as required.

context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a pure frontend Vite prototype at /app/frontend served on port 3000 via supervisor. All data lives in /app/frontend/src/api/fixtures/ and is accessed via src/api/client.ts. No backend to test. The legacy /app/apps monorepo & /app/backend FastAPI are unrelated and were intentionally ignored per review request. Session persists in localStorage key 'rollisuite.prototype.currentUserId'; hit-list done state is in-memory only (resets on hard reload — by design).
